set.name: Star Trek Away Team: The Next Generation: To Boldly Go

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Attack] MODULATING THE CLOAKING DEVICE Powers: Smoke Cloud Smoke Cloud. When Romulan Officer uses it, you may also generate a hindering terrain marker in each square within range that's occupied by a friendly character with the Romulan keyword. At the beginning of your next turn, remove these markers.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Trait] WE ARE CONDUCTING MILITARY EXERCISES...IT WOULD BE WISE IF YOU CHANGED COURSE IMMEDIATELY When Cardassian Soldier hits an adjacent opposing single-base character, after resolutions you may place that character into a square adjacent to their current square.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Attack] FERENGI ENERGY WHIP Powers: Incapacitate Incapacitate. When Ferengi Trader hits with a close attack and used Incapacitate to give action tokens, after resolutions roll a d6. [d:5]-[d:6]: Deal a hit character 1 penetrating damage.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Trait] TAME THE WARRIOR UNIQUE MODIFIER - Friendly characters that are adjacent or have the Romulan keyword modify defense +1 against close attacks.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Trait] THE BLOOD WILL TELL FREE: If a friendly character that's adjacent or has the Klingon keyword was attacked since your last turn, modify attack +1 this turn.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Trait] YOU WILL ABIDE BY STARFLEET REGULATIONS Powers: Leadership Leadership. When Starfleet Admiral uses it and succeeds, you may instead choose one: Remove an action token from a non-adjacent friendly character and that character can't attack this turn -or- Give an action token to a friendly character (you can't choose a character with two already) and if you do, Action Total +1 this turn.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Damage] ENHANCED VISOR FREE: Choose an adjacent friendly character. That character can use [it:hindering] until your next turn.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Trait] SHIFTING FOCUS: DATA FREE: If Lt. Commander Data began your turn on the map, replace him with another character with this trait on the same click number.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] IF THEY HAVE A MEANS OF DISCOVERING US, THEY MUST BE DESTROYED Friendly characters that are adjacent or have the Romulan keyword modify attack +2 when attacking only opposing characters that can use [it:hindering].
[Damage] I HAVE DISCOVERED TRAITORS AMONG US Opposing characters can't use Shape Change when attacked by friendly characters that are adjacent or have the Romulan keyword.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] ACCORDING TO THE FERENGI RULES OF ACQUISITION...WE DECLARE THIS SHIP TO BE A LOSS During the game setup, you may choose one: place one of your opponent's objects -or- generate a standard light object in any square on the map not in a starting area.
[Damage] YOU WILL COOPERATE WITH OUR SALVAGE OPERATION Opposing Equipment-Objects have Equip (Any) and Unequip (Drop) instead. When a friendly character that's adjacent or has the Ferengi keyword hits an opposing character that's equipped, after resolutions the hit character unequips their equipment.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] DEFECTOR... If Alidor Jarok is part of a Starfleet themed team, friendly charatcers that are adjacent or have the Starfleet keyword can use [it:hindering] and modify defense +1 against attacks by characters with the Romulan keyword.
[Trait] ...OR SPY? Powers: Telekinesis If Alidor Jarok is part of a Romulan themed team, he can use Telekinesis, but instead places opposing characters.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Trait] KILL HIM!...IT'S THE KLINGON WAY When a firendly character that's adjacent or has the Klingon keyword damages an opposing character with an attack, after resolutions deal that opposing character 1 penetrating damage. If that character is not KO'd, immediately heal it 1 click.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Optional Trait] MY BROTHER KURN WILL JOIN US IN BATTLE POWER: Once per game, place adjacent a TBG# 014a Kurn from your Sideline on click #1, 2, or 3. This game, Kurn can't: be carried, be equipped, be given DOUBLE POWER actions, replace or be replaced. This game, Kurn returns to your Sideline: At the beginning of your next turn, immediately if no square he occupies is within 5 squares of Worf, or he is removed from the map by another effect.
[Trait] MAY YOU DIE WELL FREE: Choose an opposing character within range that has the Klingon, Martial Artist or Warrior keyword and has 0 or 1 action tokens. At the end of the chosen character's next turn, if it did not make an attack, deal it 1 penetrating damage.
[Defense] NO MORE ROMULAN DECEPTIONS Powers: Combat Reflexes Combat Reflexes. Friendly characters that are adjacent of have the Klingon Keyword modify defense +1 against attacks by characters with the Klingon or Romulan keyword.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] I'M NOT GOING TO LEAVE AND LET YOU DIE At the beginning of your turn, Dr. Beverly Crusher can use Support at no cost, but only to target a character damaged by an opponent's attack since your last turn.
[Damage] HEAD OF STARFLEET MEDICAL Powers: Leadership, Support Leadership, Support. When Dr. Beverly Crusher or an adjacent friendly character uses Support, apply -1 instead of -2 to the result.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value: [Trait] GET THEM OUT OF THERE, O'BRIEN If Miles O'Brien has 0 or 1 action tokens, friendly characters that are adjacent or have the Starfleet keyword can use Super Senses. When a character uses this Super Senses and succeeds, give Miles O'Brien an action token and place that character adjacent to Miles O'Brien.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Title Trait] STARTING PLOT POINTS 0
[Title Trait] CONTINUITY When Captain Jean-Luc Picard, U.S.S. Enterprise is KO'd friendly characters can't make attacks on your next turn.
[Plus Plot Points] ON MY COMMAND FREE: Choose one: MOVE -or- CLOSE -or- RANGE. Actions of the chosen type given to friendly characters that are adjacent or have the Starfleet keyword don't count against your action total this turn.
[Minus Plot Points] TRANSPORTER Transporter: FREE: Choose a character on your sideline with the Starfleet keyword and a starting line for that character. You may pay 1PP plus 1PP per 10 full points of the character's cost to place that character on the starting line in an unoccupied square within 6 squares and line of fire. A force may have only one character placed by this effect on the map at a time. (Example: You would pay 5PP for a 40-49 point character.)

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Optional Trait] ALLIED WITH THE HOUSE OF DURAS During force construction, characters with the Klingon keyword gain the Romulan keyword and characters with the Romulan keyword gain the Klingon keyword.
[Trait] PLAY ON THEIR SENTIMENT Powers: Shape Change Shape Change. When a friendly character that's adjacent or has the Romulan keyword is damaged by an opponent's attack, after resolutions you may place the attacker into a square adjacent to the one it occupies.
[Damage] WEAKEN YOUR ALLIANCES Powers: Leadership Leadership. When Sela uses it and succeeds, you may instead choose that opposing characters can't use Probability Control until your next turn.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] MAJOR RAKAL OF THE TAL SHIAR Powers: Shape Change Shape Change. When a friendly character that's adjacent or has the Romulan or Starfleet keyword is damaged by an opponent's attack, choose an opposing character adjacent to the attacker. After resolutions deal the chosen character 1 penetrating damage.
[Speed] UNDERGROUND FACTION OF REBELS Powers: Mind Control Mind Control. When Deanna Troi uses it, hit characters can use [im:characters].

property.name: Traits and Special Powers

[Trait] LEAVE THIS TERRITORY OR BE DESTROYED Friendly characters that are adjacent or have the Cardassian keyword modify attack +1 when attacking characters that are closer to your starting area than their own.
[Attack] WE HAVE ALL THE EVIDENCE WE NEED...WE HAVE CAPTAIN PICARD Powers: Telekinesis Telekinesis, but instead places opposing characters.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Title Trait] STARTING PLOT POINTS 0
[Title Trait] CONTINUITY When Gul Madred, Chief Interrogator is KO'd, for the rest of the game, when an opposing character's (finalized) attack roll includes a 4, modify their damage +1.
[Plus Plot Points] NO...THERE ARE FIVE LIGHTS! FREE: Until your next turn, when an opposing character's (finalized) attack roll includes a 4, after resolutions, deal that character 1 penetrating damage.
[Minus Plot Points] TRANSPORTER FREE: Choose a character on your sideline with the Cardassian keyword and a starting line for that character. You may pay 1 Plot Point plus 1 Plot Point per 10 full points of the character's cost to place that character on the starting line in an unoccupied square within 6 squares and line of fire. A force may have only one character placed by this effect on the map at a time. (Example: You would pay 5 Plot Points for a 40-49 point character.)

[Attack] COLLECTING ON AN OLD DEBT Powers: Incapacitate Incapacitate. When Daimon Bok uses it, after resolutions give the hit character a Debt token. // Characters modify attack and defense -1 for each Debt token they have. (Only as long as he can use this power.)
[Defense] HAVEN'T BEEN SLEEPING WELL? Powers: Mastermind, Willpower Mastermind, Willpower. Opposing characters within range can't use Willpower.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] HOLODECK SAFETY PROTOCOLS At the beginning of the game, give Professor Moriarty 3 Safety Protocol tokens. While he has a Safety Protocol token, opposing characters take a maximum of 1 damage from his attacks. // When Professor Moriarty uses Outwit, after resolutions remove a Safety Protocol token.
[Damage] OVERRIDING COMMAND CONTROLS Powers: Outwit, Perplex Outwit, Perplex. When Professor Moriarty uses either to target an opposing character, until your next turn the target can't use team abilities and Professor Moriarty can use any team abilities the target can't use through this effect.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] OPPORTUNISTIC MANEUVER FREE: Once per turn, for all characters that can use this trait, choose a friendly character that took 2 or more damage from a single attack since your last turn. You may place Geordi La Forge within 6 squares and line of fire of the opposing character that made that attack. You may then replace Mirror Geordi La Forge with another character that can use the Opportunistic Maneuver trait from your sideline (on the same click number).
[Trait] ADVANCING THROUGH THE RANKS When this character is placed by a character's use of the Opportunistic Maneuver trait, until your next turn, this character has "When an opposing character within 6 squares is given a FREE action, after resolutions deal that character 1 penetrating damage."
[Trait] MIRROR, MIRROR Powers: Shape Change Shape Change. When Mirror Geordi La Forge uses Shape Change and succeeds, give him a Mirror token and, if he fails, remove all Mirror tokens. When he uses Shape Change, increase the result by +1 for each Mirror token (a roll of [d:1] always fails).
[Attack] REROUTING BRIDGE CONTROLS Once per turn, when an opposing character within range would use an effect that allows it to choose standard power(s) to use, you may make them choose again, but they must choose different power(s) than before.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] OPPORTUNISTIC MANEUVER FREE: Once per turn, for all characters that can use this trait, choose a friendly character that took 2 or more damage from a single attack since your last turn. You may place Mirror Jen-Luc Picard within 6 squares and line of fire of the opposing character that made the attack. You may then replace Mirror Jean-Luc Picard with another character that can use the Opportunistic Maneuver trait from your sideline (on the same click number).
[Trait] ADVANCING THROUGH THE RANKS When this character is placed by a character's use of the Opportunistic Maneuver trait, until your next turn, this character has "Opposing characters within 6 squares can't use Leadership, Mastermind or Perplex."
[Trait] MIRROR, MIRROR Powers: Shape Change Shape Change. When Mirror Jen-Luc Picard uses Shape Change and succeeds, give him a Mirror token, and if he fails, remove all Mirror tokens. When he uses Shape Change, increase the result +1 for each Mirror token (a roll of [d:1] always fails).
[Damage] TO ENSLAVE NEW LIFE AND NEW CIVILIZATIONS Powers: Leadership Leadership. When Mirror Jean-Luc Picard uses it, if there is no d6 on this card, you may place the d6 result on this card. // When a character within range rolls an attack roll or rolls for Blades/Claws/Fangs or Leadership, you may remove the d6 from this card and replace a die in the roll with it.
